body.text: Boss1 map-v2 progress: three Boss1-owned 3A packets completed and pushed on rebuild/research-v2. Completed comparisons: (1) M-b fixed-domain strict chain P624 ⊊ P616 ⊊ P332 ⊊ ⋂P76, with D17 padding explicitly scoped; (2) M-e394 34-row cone plus shared-source two-branch PAIR joint hidden-state projection, including the 13-atom strict witness and five 5716 cuts; (3) maximal-root true-tail necessary root lines and H=0 obstruction from CAG-MODEL plus all-m rigidity. Reused accepted canonical edges without duplicate logical edges. Remaining obligations stay explicit: no full SPE/2W≥OPT6 or six-person half theorem, no global 624 closure, and pending integration/repair batches remain visible. Latest research commit: a386c868eac6bf043f82107fb84a40a2e5312ba2.
